question_evidence_quote: a discount clinic that is 70% cheaper
observed_error: The response treats the 70% discount as the percentage of the normal fee charged.
violated_condition: A fee 70% cheaper than $200 is (1 − 0.70) × $200 per visit.
error_description: The response sets the discount clinic's per-visit charge to 70% of $200, although “70% cheaper” means subtracting 70% from the normal fee and paying the remaining 30%. Its subsequent arithmetic correctly follows the written expression, but uses the wrong per-visit cost for both visits.
